crossRefs.note: When the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together…
“How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?
How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
“Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.
If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.
If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.
Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.
Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

translations.web: Eli said to her, “How long will you be drunk? Get rid of your wine!”
translations.bsb: and said to her, “How long will you be drunk? Put away your wine!”
translations.kjv: And Eli said unto her, How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.
translations.asv: And Eli said unto her, How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.
